# CEFAZOLIN:

Postoperative antimicrobial administration for preventing SSI is not

necessary for most procedures. The duration of antimicrobial prophylaxis

should be less than 24 hours.

# Cefazolin Postop Dose based on patient weight:

[<Click here> Display last recorded patient weight \(limited to 2 years\)](orz-gtx-abx-weight-for-abx-dosing)

# Weight <120 kg:

[Cefazolin 2GM IVPB q8hours X2 doses Postop](psjizid-cefazolin-2gm-ivpb-q8h-x-2doses-postop)

# Weight >/= 120 kg:

[Cefazolin 3GM IVPB q8hours X2 doses Postop](psjizid-cefazolin-3-gm-postop-x2doses-for-wt-greater-than-120kg)
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU SURG CEFAZOLIN WT BASED POSTOP DOSES X2
